title: How I Killed Ten Thousand Wardens in Minecraft
description:
Let's do something fun to promote one of my favourite projects in the Technical Minecraft Community, The Archivist, a group of technically minded minecraft players who have dedicated their time to making amazingly simple tutorials for useful builds. In this video we will follow one of their tutorials to make a machine that lets us slaughter the Warden mob on mass.

The Archivist is an Ambitious project, so go show them some support:
